articles.title: Most-favoured-nation pricing for prescription drugs in US Medicare: a cohort study
articles.authors: Hwang TJ, Hediger S, Krishnan A, Cai CL, Kesselheim AS, Vokinger KN

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The prices of new medicines in the USA are among the highest in the world. The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services released mandatory most-favoured-nation payment models for prescription drugs covered under Medicare part B (GLOBE) and part D (GUARD). Under these payment models, manufacturers would be required to pay Medicare additional rebates for net drug prices exceeding the lowest international list price in a basket of 19 reference countries adjusted by gross domestic product per capita on purchasing power parity basis. In this study, we aimed to model the impact of the GLOBE and GUARD models for Medicare spending.
abstract.textZh: 美國的新藥價格是世界上最高的。Medicare和Medicaid服務中心發布了Medicare B部分（ GLOBE ）和D部分（ GUARD ）承保的處方藥的強制性最惠國付款模式。在這些付款模式下，製造商將被要求為超過19個參考國家（按購買力平價基礎按人均國內生產總值調整）的最低國際定價的淨藥品價格支付Medicare額外回扣。在這項研究中，我們的目標是模擬全球的影響，並保護醫療保險支出模式。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this cohort study of the GLOBE and GUARD payment models in US Medicare, we linked Medicare spending and prices with estimated current rebates, ex-manufacturer prices, and international sales data using Medicare data and commercial databases of sales and pricing from 19 model-specified reference countries (ie, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Czechia, Denmark, France, Germany, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Netherlands, Norway, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and the UK) for all potential model-eligible brand-name drugs. The primary outcomes were estimated reductions in net Medicare spending under the GLOBE and GUARD payment models and median ratio of estimated reductions in Medicare spending to annual sales in the referenced country. In scenario analyses, we estimated changes in potential savings if the reference basket was narrowed to G7 countries and if manufacturers with separate agreements with the Department of Health and Human Services were exempt from model inclusion.
abstract.textZh: 在這項針對全球和美國聯邦醫療保險(Medicare)保護支付模式的隊列研究中，我們將聯邦醫療保險(Medicare)的支出和價格與目前的預估回饋金、前製造商價格和國際銷售數據聯繫起來，該數據使用聯邦醫療保險(Medicare)數據和來自19個特定型號參考國家（即澳大利亞、奧地利、比利時、加拿大、捷克、丹麥、法國、德國、愛爾蘭、以色列、意大利、日本、荷蘭、挪威、韓國、西班牙、瑞典、瑞士和英國）的銷售和定價的商業數據庫。 主要結果是全球醫療保險淨支出的估計減少，並保護支付模式以及參考國家醫療保險支出預計減少與年銷售額的中位數比率。 在情境分析中，我們估計，如果參考籃子縮小到G7國家，以及與衛生與公共服務部有單獨協議的製造商免於模型納入，則潛在節省的變化。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: The study included 195 brand-name drugs accounting for Medicare spending of US$87·9 billion. The estimated reductions in net Medicare spending were $5·2 billion (16·1%) under GLOBE and $6·4 billion (17·6%) under GUARD. In scenario analyses, potential savings would be reduced by 12·2% if the reference basket was narrowed to G7 countries and 71·3% if manufacturers with separate agreements were exempt from model participation. The median ratio of estimated reductions in Medicare net spending under GLOBE and GUARD to annual sales in the binding lowest referenced country was 3·8 (IQR 1·0-22·8). For 101 (73·2%) of 138 drugs, estimated reductions in Medicare spending would exceed annual sales in the binding referenced country.
abstract.textZh: 該研究包括195種名牌藥物，佔聯邦醫療保險支出$ 879億美元。據估計，全球醫療保險淨支出減少52億$ （ 16.1 ％ ） ，受保護的$ 64億美元（ 17.6 ％ ）。在情景分析中，如果參考籃子縮小到G7國家，潛在的節省將減少12.2 ％ ，如果具有單獨協議的製造商免於參與模型，潛在節省將減少71.3 ％。受約束最低參考國家/地區的全球醫療保險淨支出預估減少量與年銷售額的中位數比率為3.8 （ IQR 1 · 0-22 · 8 ）。對於138種藥物中的101種（ 73.2 ％ ） ，預計Medicare支出的減少將超過受約束的參考國家的年銷售額。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Most-favoured-nation pricing for brand-name medicines in Medicare was projected to decrease net spending. Potential reductions in net Medicare spending would be substantially greater than sales in the reference countries, suggesting that shifts in manufacturer behaviour with model implementation could reduce possible savings.
abstract.textZh: Medicare中品牌藥物的最惠國定價預計將減少淨支出。醫療保險淨支出的潛在減少將大大超過參考國家的銷售額，這表明通過實施模型來改變製造商的行為可能會減少可能的節省。

articles.title: Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia (ENERGIZE-T): a double-blind, randomised, multicentre, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
articles.authors: Cappellini MD, Sheth S, Taher A, Al-Samkari H, Antmen AB, Beneitez D, Cannas G, Coates T, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The absence of disease-modifying therapies for patients with α-thalassaemia and oral disease-modifying therapies for patients with β-thalassaemia has been a substantial unmet need in these patients. We assessed the efficacy and safety of mitapivat, an oral allosteric activator of pyruvate kinase, in adults with transfusion-dependent thalassaemia.
abstract.textZh: Α地中海貧血患者缺乏疾病修飾療法， β地中海貧血患者缺乏口腔疾病修飾療法，一直是這些患者實質上未滿足的需求。我們評估了丙酮酸激酶的口服變構激活劑mitapivat在患有輸血依賴性地中海貧血的成年人中的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: ENERGIZE-T is a global, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial, conducted across 19 countries in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, South America, and the Middle East. Patients aged 18 years or older with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia were randomly allocated (2:1) with a central interactive response technology system, stratified by geographical region and thalassaemia genotype, to receive 100 mg mitapivat or placebo orally twice a day for 48 weeks. The primary endpoint was transfusion reduction response (TRR), defined as a reduction of at least 50% in transfused red blood cell units with a reduction of at least two units in any consecutive 12-week period until week 48 compared with baseline. Efficacy was analysed in the full analysis set, comprising all randomly allocated patients. Type, severity, and relationship of adverse events and serious adverse events were assessed in patients who received at least one dose of study treatment. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04770779) and is active but not recruiting.
abstract.textZh: ENERGIZE-T是一項全球性、雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照的3期試驗，在北美、歐洲、亞太、南美和中東的19個國家進行。 18歲或以上患有輸血依賴性α-地中海貧血或β-地中海貧血的患者被隨機分配(2: 1)中央互動反應技術系統，按地理區域和地中海貧血基因型分層，每天兩次口服100毫克米他韋或安慰劑，持續48週。 主要終點是輸血減量反應(TRR) ，定義為輸血紅細胞單位相較於基線期減少至少50% ，且在任何連續12週期間減少至少2個單位，直至第48週。 在完整的分析集中分析有效性，包括所有隨機分配的患者。 在接受至少一劑研究治療的患者中評估不良事件和嚴重不良事件的類型、嚴重程度和關係。 本研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT04770779 ）註冊，目前正在進行，但尚未招募。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Nov 30, 2021 and May 2, 2023, 305 patients were screened, of whom 258 were randomly allocated (median age 33·5 years [IQR 27·0-44·0]; 136 [53%] female and 122 [47%] male participants). Of 258 patients allocated, 238 (92%) completed the double-blind treatment period. All patients were required to have a safety follow-up approximately 4 weeks after the final dose of study drug, regardless of completion of the double-blind period or continuation into the open-label extension period. In the full analysis set, TRRs occurred in 52 (30%) of 171 patients in the mitapivat group and 11 (13%) of 87 in the placebo group (adjusted difference 18 percentage points [95% CI 8-27]; two-sided p=0·0003). The safety analysis set comprised 172 patients in the mitapivat group (including one patient allocated to the placebo group who received one dose of mitapivat in error) and 85 in the placebo group. Adverse events were reported in 155 (90%) patients treated with mitapivat and 71 (84%) treated with placebo; the most common events with mitapivat were headache, upper respiratory tract infection, initial insomnia, diarrhoea, and fatigue. Serious adverse events were reported in 19 (11%) patients treated with mitapivat and 13 (15%) treated with placebo. Ten (6%) patients who received mitapivat and one (1%) who received placebo discontinued study treatment due to adverse events. No deaths were reported.
abstract.textZh: 2021年11月30日至2023年5月2日期間，篩選了305名患者，其中258名患者被隨機分配（中位年齡33 · 5歲[IQR 27 · 0-44 · 0] ； 136名[53%]女性和122名[47%]男性參與者）。 在分配的258名患者中， 238名（ 92% ）完成了雙盲治療期。 無論是否完成雙盲期或是否繼續進入開放標籤延長期，所有患者都必須在研究藥物最終劑量後約4週進行安全性追蹤。 在完整的分析集中， mitapivat組171名患者中的52名（ 30% ）和安慰劑組87名患者中的11名（ 13% ）發生TRR （調整差異18個百分點[95% CI 8-27] ；雙側p = 0.0003 ）。 安全性分析集包括mitapivat組的172名患者（包括分配給安慰劑組的一名錯誤接受一劑mitapivat的患者）和安慰劑組的85名患者。 155名(90%)接受mitapivat治療的患者和71名(84%)接受安慰劑治療的患者報告了不良事件； mitapivat最常見的事件是頭痛、上呼吸道感染、初期失眠、腹瀉和疲勞。 使用mitapivat治療的19 (11%)名患者報告了嚴重不良事件，使用安慰劑治療的13 (15%)名患者報告了嚴重不良事件。 10名(6%)接受mitapivat的患者和1名(1%)接受安慰劑的患者因不良事件而停止研究治療。 未報告死亡。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Mitapivat significantly reduced the transfusion burden and was generally well tolerated, showing a favourable benefit-risk profile. These findings support mitapivat as the first oral disease-modifying therapy for adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia, providing a new treatment option to reduce transfusion burden in this patient population.
abstract.textZh: Mitapivat顯著降低輸血負擔，並且通常具有良好的耐受性，顯示出良好的收益-風險狀況。這些發現支持mitapivat作為針對輸血依賴性α-地中海貧血或β-地中海貧血的成年人的第一種口服疾病修飾療法，為該患者羣體提供減輕輸血負擔的新治療選擇。

articles.title: The changing therapeutic landscape of small-cell lung cancer
articles.authors: Ross JS, Hockemeyer KG, Redin E, Rudin CM

abstract.text: Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an exceptionally aggressive malignancy: highly proliferative, heterogeneous, and frequently metastatic at diagnosis. Although initially responsive to chemotherapy, such responses are typically transient, and recurrent disease has been largely refractory to standard cytotoxics. The past decade has been notable for major advances in our understanding of SCLC biology, and this preclinical progress is now informing multiple novel therapeutic approaches for this disease. Of particular note, defining cell-surface proteins that are uniquely or differentially expressed in SCLC has led to various targeted therapies showing substantial preliminary evidence of efficacy in patients with SCLC. Approaches in active development include T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, radioconjugates, and cell therapies, among others. In this Series paper, we summarise current standards of care, recent advances, and highlight emerging approaches showing early promise for better management of SCLC. Together, these advances are providing new hope for patients with what has been a particularly lethal disease.
abstract.textZh: 小細胞肺癌（ SCLC ）是一種極具侵襲性的惡性腫瘤：診斷時具有高度增殖性、異質性和經常轉移性。 雖然最初對化療有反應，但這種反應通常是短暫的，復發性疾病對標準細胞毒素基本上是難治的。 過去十年來，我們對SCLC生物學的理解取得了重大進展，這一臨牀前進展現在為這種疾病的多種新型治療方法提供了信息。 特別值得注意的是，定義在SCLC中獨特或差異表達的細胞表面蛋白導致各種靶向療法顯示出在SCLC患者中有效的實質性初步證據。 積極發展的方法包括T細胞接合劑、抗體-藥物偶聯物、放射性偶聯物和細胞療法等。 在本系列論文中，我們總結了當前的護理標準，最近的進展，並強調了新興方法，這些方法顯示了更好地管理SCLC的早期前景。 這些進展共同為患有特別致命疾病的患者提供了新的希望。

articles.title: Porcine kidney xenotransplantation as a bridge to allotransplantation: a first-in-human study
articles.authors: Riella LV, Borges TJ, Rosales IA, Avillach CT, Palsson R, Hullekes F, Verhoeff R, Pomahac A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Kidney xenotransplantation offers a potential solution to the organ shortage, but questions remain regarding durability, zoonotic infection risk, and whether the immunological response to the xenograft elicits sensitisation that could complicate subsequent allotransplantation. We report outcomes from a porcine kidney xenograft in a living recipient followed by human allotransplantation.
abstract.textZh: 腎臟異種移植為器官短缺提供了一種潛在的解決方案，但關於耐久性，人畜共患感染風險以及對異種移植的免疫反應是否會引起致敏，從而可能使後續同種異體移植複雜化的問題仍然存在。我們報告了活體受者豬腎異種移植後人類同種異體移植的結果。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: A patient with end-stage kidney disease, a prolonged anticipated waiting time for deceased donor transplantation, and with no suitable living donor underwent transplantation at Massachusetts General Hospital (Boston, MA, USA) with a gene-edited porcine kidney (EGEN-2784; eGenesis [Cambridge, MA, USA]) incorporating the deletion of major glycan xenoantigens, inactivation of porcine endogenous retroviruses, and insertion of seven human transgenes. The recipient received costimulation blockade-based immunosuppression with complement inhibition. Monitoring included renal function, flow cytometric crossmatch, anti-HLA antibodies, and porcine microbial surveillance, including metagenomic sequencing. This report describes the first recipient in a planned three-patient study conducted under a US Food and Drug Administration Expanded Access Investigational New Drug application.
abstract.textZh: 患有末期腎臟疾病的患者，預計死者捐贈者移植的等待時間延長，且沒有合適的活體捐贈者在麻薩諸塞州總醫院（美國麻薩諸塞州波士頓）接受移植，其中基因編輯的豬腎（ EGEN-2784 ； eGenesis [麻薩諸塞州劍橋，美國] ）包含主要醣異種抗原的缺失、豬內源性逆轉錄病毒的失活和七個人類轉基因的插入。接受者接受了基於共刺激阻斷的免疫抑制和補體抑制。監測包括腎功能、流式細胞交叉配對、抗HLA抗體和豬微生物監測，包括宏基因組測序。這份報告描述了根據美國食品和藥物管理局擴大獲取新藥研究申請進行的計劃中的三位患者研究中的第一位受試者。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: The xenograft functioned immediately after transplantation on Jan 25, 2025, and sustained dialysis independence for 271 days. A biopsy on day 14 showed T-cell-mediated rejection, which resolved with treatment. Graft function remained stable for approximately 6 months until immunosuppression was reduced in the setting of non-zoonotic bacterial infection. Microvascular inflammation with endothelial injury subsequently emerged, progressing to thrombotic microangiopathy despite persistently negative donor-specific crossmatch, leading to graft failure and nephrectomy. Tissue analysis showed a macrophage and natural-killer-cell-predominant infiltrate with minimal T-cell involvement. No porcine pathogen transmission was detected. Anti-HLA antibodies remained unchanged. 82 days after explantation, the patient underwent human kidney allotransplantation with immediate graft function and no evidence of sensitisation during 231 days of follow-up.
abstract.textZh: 異種移植物在2025年1月25日移植後立即發揮作用，並持續透析獨立271天。第14天的活組織檢查顯示T細胞介導的排斥反應，該排斥反應隨著治療而消退。移植物功能在大約6個月內保持穩定，直到在非人畜共患細菌感染的情況下免疫抑制減少。隨後出現帶有內皮損傷的微血管炎症，儘管供體特異性交叉配型持續陰性，但仍發展為血栓性微血管病變，導致移植物失敗和腎切除。組織分析顯示巨噬細胞和天然殺手細胞為主的浸潤， T細胞受影響最小。未檢測到豬病原體傳播。抗HLA抗體維持不變。手術後82天，患者接受了人類腎臟同種異體移植，具有立即移植功能，在231天的隨訪期間沒有致敏的證據。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: This case shows that porcine kidney xenotransplantation can provide prolonged renal support and be discontinued without clinically significant allosensitisation or zoonotic infection. Early cellular rejection resolved with treatment, whereas later graft failure was associated with microvascular injury progressing to thrombotic microangiopathy despite a negative donor-specific crossmatch, supporting the possibility that mechanisms beyond conventional antibody-mediated rejection contributed to late graft injury. Kidney xenotransplantation has the potential to provide prolonged dialysis-free support while also serving as a bridge to subsequent human allotransplantation.
abstract.textZh: 該病例表明，豬腎異種移植可以提供長時間的腎臟支持，並且在沒有臨牀顯著同種異體增敏或人畜共患感染的情況下停止。早期細胞排斥通過治療得到解決，而後來的移植物失敗與微血管損傷有關，儘管捐贈者特異性交叉匹配為陰性，但仍發展為血栓性微血管病變，這支持了超越傳統抗體介導的排斥機制導致晚期移植物損傷的可能性。腎臟異種移植有可能提供長期的無透析支持，同時也可以作為後續人類同種異體移植的橋樑。

articles.title: Catheter ablation for symptomatic atrial fibrillation (PVI-SHAM-AF): a randomised, double-blind, sham-controlled, multicentre trial
articles.authors: Wachter R, Haag P, Uhe T, Bacak M, Petroff D, Forkmann M, Eckardt L, Gaspar T, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Guidelines recommend catheter ablation for symptom relief in patients with atrial fibrillation. The aim of this trial was to ascertain whether catheter ablation improves atrial fibrillation-related quality of life more than a sham procedure.
abstract.textZh: 指南建議導管消融以緩解心房顫動患者的症狀。本試驗的目的是確定導管消融是否比假手術更能改善與心房顫動相關的生活質量。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: PVI-SHAM-AF was a double-blind, multicentre, randomised trial conducted at nine study sites in Germany and Poland. Patients aged 18 years or older with symptomatic paroxysmal or persistent atrial fibrillation were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to catheter ablation or a sham procedure using an automated online randomisation system with variable block sizes, stratified by trial site. The primary endpoint was the between-group difference in change from baseline to 6 months in the Atrial Fibrillation Effect on the Quality-of-life Questionnaire (AFEQT) summary score. The prespecified primary analysis was done in the intention-to-treat population and included all randomly assigned patients, with missing data handled by multiple imputation. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05119231) and 12-month follow-up is ongoing.
abstract.textZh: PVI-SHAM-AF是一項在德國和波蘭的九個研究中心進行的雙盲、多中心、隨機試驗。18歲或以上有症狀的發作性或持續性心房顫動的患者，以2: 1的比例隨機分配到導管消融或假手術，使用具有可變塊大小的自動線上隨機分組系統，並按試驗部位分層。主要評估指標是生活品質問卷(AFEQT)心房顫動效應(Atrial Fibrillation Effect on the Quality-of-life Questionnaire, AFEQT)總分從基線到6個月之間變化的組間差異。預先指定的主要分析是在意向治療族羣中進行的，包括所有隨機分配的患者，缺失的數據由多重估算處理。此試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT05119231 ）註冊，並且正在進行12個月的隨訪。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Nov 12, 2021, and Nov 3, 2025, 1199 patients were invited to participate in the study and 262 patients consented and were randomly assigned: 173 patients to catheter ablation and 89 to sham. The median age was 67 years (IQR 62-73); 134 (51%) were female and 128 (49%) were male. Median follow-up was 184 days (IQR 181-191). At 6 months, the mean AFEQT summary score had increased from 61·3 (SD 20·1) to 81·1 (16·6) in the catheter ablation group and from 59·2 (19·0) to 74·9 (19·5) in the sham control group. The Hodges-Lehmann estimate of the between-group difference in change was 2·6 (95% CI -2·7 to 8·0; p=0·36). One death occurred in each group; neither was considered related to the study procedure. Serious adverse events adjudicated as related or possibly related to the study procedure occurred in ten unique patients: six patients in the catheter ablation group and four patients in the sham control group. One of these was an ischaemic stroke occurred in the sham control group.

articles.title: Bundibugyo virus glycoprotein seroreactivity following recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus-Zaire Ebola virus glycoprotein vaccination in outbreak-affected populations of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a longitudinal cohort study
articles.authors: Halbrook M, Merritt S, Hoff NA, Mukadi P, Kompany JP, Musene K, Beya M, Kalengi H, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: There are currently no licensed vaccines for disease caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). The recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus-Zaire Ebola virus glycoprotein (rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP) vaccine has been widely deployed during Ebola virus disease outbreaks caused by Ebola virus (EBOV). Human studies have shown cross-reactive BDBV antibody responses following licensed Ebola virus disease vaccine administration, but the durability and longitudinal kinetics of these responses in populations vaccinated during outbreaks remain unknown. We aimed to evaluate BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity following rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP vaccination in two longitudinal cohorts from regions of the Democratic Republic of the Congo affected by Ebola virus disease outbreaks.
abstract.textZh: 目前沒有針對Bundibugyo病毒（ BDBV ）引起的疾病的許可疫苗。重組水泡性口炎病毒-扎伊爾埃博拉病毒糖蛋白（ rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP ）疫苗已在埃博拉病毒（ EBOV ）引起的埃博拉病毒疾病爆發期間廣泛應用。人體研究表明，在獲得許可的伊波拉病毒疾病疫苗注射後， BDBV抗體會產生交叉反應，但在疫情期間接種疫苗的人羣中，這些反應的持久性和縱向動力學仍然未知。我們旨在評估來自剛果民主共和國受伊波拉病毒疾病爆發影響地區的兩個縱向隊列中rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP疫苗接種後的BDBV糖蛋白血清反應性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This longitudinal cohort study was done in Mbandaka, Equateur Province, and Beni, North Kivu Province. Individuals aged 1 year and older who received the rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP vaccine under the WHO ring-vaccination protocol were eligible for enrolment. These populations were defined as: people with confirmed Ebola virus disease, contacts of people with Ebola virus disease or contacts-of-contacts, and health-care or front-line workers in areas affected by Ebola virus disease. Participants were enrolled from June 2 to July 3, 2018, in Mbandaka and from Aug 15 to 29, 2018, in Beni. Serum samples were collected from vaccine recipients and antibody reactivity was assessed using a multiplex pan-filovirus immunoassay. Both cohorts were followed up over 5 years, with seven data collection periods in each province. We evaluated longitudinal trends in EBOV and BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity using a pan-filovirus multiplex immunoassay across follow-up visits.
abstract.textZh: 這項縱向隊列研究是在赤道省姆班達卡和北基伍省貝尼進行的。根據WHO環狀疫苗接種協議接種rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP疫苗的1歲及以上個體有資格入組。這些人羣被定義為：確診伊波拉病毒病患者、伊波拉病毒病患者或接觸者的接觸者，以及受伊波拉病毒病影響地區的醫療保健或前線工作者。參與者於2018年6月2日至7月3日在姆班達卡和2018年8月15日至29日在貝尼入組。從疫苗接受者收集血清樣本，並使用多重泛纖維病毒免疫測定法評估抗體反應性。兩個隊列均在5年內進行追蹤，每個省份有7個數據收集期。我們在隨訪期間使用泛線粒體多重免疫分析評估了EBOV和BDBV糖蛋白血清反應的縱向趨勢。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: We analysed 5849 serum samples from 1081 participants. 715 (66%) of 1081 participants were male and 366 (34%) were female. BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity differed substantially between study sites. At baseline, 16 (3%) of 482 participants in Mbandaka and 62 (10%) of 599 in Beni were seroreactive to BDBV glycoprotein. In Mbandaka, BDBV glycoprotein antibody reactivity remained stable through to 6 months after initial vaccination before increasing from a mean median fluorescent intensity (MFI) of 1238 (SD 1599) at 2·5 years, with 16 (5%) of 355 seroreactive, to 4845 (5881) at 3·5 years and 116 (35%) of 329 seroreactive (p<0·0001), followed by waning at later visits. In Beni, BDBV glycoprotein antibody reactivity increased rapidly after the initial vaccination, with seroreactivity peaking at 21 days to a mean MFI of 6678 (SD 6997) with 283 (52%) of 541 participants seroreactive and at 6 months to an MFI of 6852 (6560) with 270 (54%) of 501 seroreactive. Although antibody levels decreased after 6 months, EBOV glycoprotein and BDBV glycoprotein antibody reactivity remained above baseline through to 5 years after vaccination.
abstract.textZh: 我們分析了1081名參與者的5849份血清樣本。1081名參與者中有715名（ 66 ％ ）為男性， 366名（ 34 ％ ）為女性。 不同研究中心之間的BDBV糖蛋白血清反應性差異很大。 在基線時， Mbandaka的482名參與者中有16名（ 3% ）對BDBV糖蛋白有血清反應， Beni的599名參與者中有62名（ 10% ）對BDBV糖蛋白有血清反應。 在Mbandaka ， BDBV糖蛋白抗體反應在初次疫苗接種後保持穩定直至6個月，然後從2 · 5年的平均螢光強度中位數（ MFI ） 1238 （ SD 1599 ） ， 355血清反應性的16 （ 5 ％ ） ，增加到3 · 5年的4845 （ 5881 ）和329血清反應性的116 （ 35 ％ ） （ p < 0 · 0001 ） ，然後在後的就診時減弱。 在貝尼， BDBV糖蛋白抗體反應在初次疫苗接種後迅速增加，血清反應在21天時達到峯值，平均MFI為6678 （ SD 6997 ） ， 541名參與者中有283名（ 52 ％ ）血清反應，在6個月時， MFI為6852 （ 6560 ） ， 501名中有270名（ 54 ％ ）血清反應。 雖然抗體水平在6個月後下降，但EBOV糖蛋白和BDBV糖蛋白抗體反應性在疫苗接種後一直保持高於基線至5年。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: The differing patterns of BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity observed between Beni and Mbandaka warrant further investigation into the epidemiological and immunological factors associated with this seroreactivity, including the epidemiological significance of baseline seroreactivity observed before vaccination. To our knowledge, these findings provide the first longitudinal human data describing BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity following licensed Ebola virus disease vaccination in populations living in regions now affected by the current outbreak of disease caused by BDBV. They add to the growing body of human evidence describing cross-reactive antibody responses following licensed Ebola virus disease vaccination and support rigorous clinical evaluation of rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP during the ongoing outbreak while BDBV-specific vaccines continue to be developed.
abstract.textZh: 在Beni和Mbandaka之間觀察到的BDBV糖蛋白血清反應的不同模式值得進一步研究與此血清反應相關的流行病學和免疫學因素，包括疫苗接種前觀察到的基線血清反應的流行病學意義。據我們所知，這些發現提供了第一個描述BDBV糖蛋白血清反應的縱向人類數據，該數據是在居住在目前受BDBV引起的疾病爆發影響的地區的人羣中進行許可的伊波拉病毒疾病疫苗接種之後。它們增加了描述許可伊波拉病毒疾病疫苗接種後交叉反應性抗體反應的日益增長的人類證據，並支持在持續爆發期間對rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP進行嚴格的臨牀評估，同時繼續開發BDBV特異性疫苗。

articles.title: Immunogenicity of fractional one-fifth and one-half doses of 17DD yellow fever vaccine compared with full dose in children aged 9-23 months in Uganda: a phase 4, single-blind, randomised clinical trial
articles.authors: Doshi RH, Lubega I, Muhoza P, Carlock G, Sekiziyivu AB, Tuttle A, Najjengo M, Kayiwa J, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Fractional doses of yellow fever vaccines have been shown to be safe and immunogenic in randomised controlled trials in adults and children. However, little evidence still remains in children younger than 2 years. We assessed immunogenicity of one-fifth (0·1 mL) and one-half (0·25 mL) fractional doses compared with full doses of 17DD yellow fever vaccine in children aged 9-23 months in Kampala, Uganda.
abstract.textZh: 在成人和兒童的隨機對照試驗中，部分劑量的黃熱病疫苗已被證明是安全和免疫原性的。然而， 2歲以下兒童的證據仍然很少。我們評估了烏幹達坎帕拉9-23個月兒童的五分之一（ 0 · 1mL ）和二分之一（ 0 · 25mL ）分次劑量與全劑量17DD黃熱病疫苗的免疫原性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This phase 4, single-blind, randomised clinical trial evaluating fractional dose 17DD yellow fever vaccine among children was conducted at three public-sector health facilities in Uganda. Eligible participants were aged 9-23 months at enrolment, had no history of yellow fever disease or vaccination, and did not meet the exclusion criteria. Children were enrolled in three age strata: 9-12 months, 13-18 months, and 19-23 months, and were randomly assigned (1:1:1) using block randomisation (block sizes of three and six) to one-fifth (0·1 mL), one-half (0·25 mL), or full (0·5 mL) doses of the 17DD yellow fever vaccine. Participants were followed up at 4 weeks (visit 1 [V1]), 1 year (visit 2 [V2]), and 13-48 months (visit 3 [V3]) after vaccination. The primary analysis included per-protocol participants who attended within the prespecified visit window; an intention-to-treat analysis was also conducted including all randomly assigned participants with available outcome data. Participants with missing serological data were excluded from the analysis at the corresponding visit. The primary outcome was non-inferiority in seroconversion (5 percentage-point margin) at V1 measured by 50% plaque reduction neutralisation test. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT03725618, and is complete.
abstract.textZh: 這項評估兒童接種分次劑量17DD黃熱病疫苗的第4期單盲隨機臨牀試驗在烏幹達的三個公共衛生機構進行。 符合資格的參與者在入組時年齡為9-23個月，沒有黃熱病史或疫苗接種史，不符合排除標準。 兒童入組三個年齡層： 9-12個月、13-18個月和19-23個月，並使用塊隨機分配（塊大小為3和6 ）至五分之一（ 0 · 1mL ）、一半（ 0 · 25mL ）或完整（ 0 · 5mL ）劑量的17DD黃熱病疫苗隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ： 1 ）。 參與者在疫苗接種後第4週（回診1 [V1] ）、第1年（回診2 [V2] ）和第13-48個月（回診3 [V3] ）進行追蹤。 主要分析包括在預先指定的回診時段內參加的符合方案的參與者；還進行了意向治療分析，其中包括所有可用結果數據的隨機分配參與者。 缺少血清學數據的參與者被排除在相應回診的分析之外。 主要結果是通過50 ％斑塊減少中和測試測得的V1血清轉換的非劣效性（ 5個百分點邊際）。 本研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov註冊，編號為NCT03725618 ，已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between March 26, 2019, and May 11, 2021, 1784 participants were randomly assigned to either one-fifth dose (n=600), one-half dose (n=594), or full dose (n=590). The median (IQR) age at enrolment was 13 (11-18) months. Both fractional doses met the non-inferiority criterion compared with the full dose with no difference in seroconversion between one-fifth and full doses and -0·17 (95% CI -0·52 to 0·17) difference between one-half and full doses in the per-protocol population at V1. There was no difference between the one-fifth and full doses.
abstract.textZh: 在2019年3月26日至2021年5月11日期間， 1784名參與者被隨機分配到五分之一劑量（ n = 600 ）、一半劑量（ n = 594 ）或全劑量（ n = 590 ）。入組時的中位數(IQR)年齡為13 (11-18)個月。與全劑量相比，兩種分數劑量均符合非劣效性標準，在V1期間，符合方案的人羣中，五分之一劑量和全劑量之間的血清轉換沒有差異，半劑量和全劑量之間的差異為-0 · 17 (95% CI -0 · 52至0 · 17)。五分之一劑量和全劑量之間沒有差異。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Both fractional doses of 17DD yellow fever vaccine were non-inferior to full doses in inducing initial seroconversion. The results support the use of fractional dose yellow fever vaccines among young children for outbreak response during supply shortages.

articles.title: Treatment Decisions in Multiple Myeloma
articles.authors: Mouhieddine TH, Anderson KC

abstract.text: Revolutions in transplantation and targeted and immune therapies have transformed multiple myeloma from a disease with an associated survival of a few years into one for which functional cure is an emerging goal. This abundance of effective therapies has created clinical complexity. Here we provide a practical framework, anchored in trial evidence and informed by emerging biologic discoveries, for the navigation of treatment decisions across the disease spectrum. We outline how cytogenetic and genomic risk stratification, functional fitness, and measurable residual disease status individualize therapy in newly diagnosed disease, in which quadruplet induction therapy is now standard and the role of autologous transplantation is being reevaluated. Regarding relapse, we address the sequencing of B-cell maturation antigen-directed chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells, bispecific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates, emphasizing T-cell fitness and multiantigen targeting to counter exhaustion and antigen escape. We also consider early interception in high-risk smoldering myeloma. Throughout, we underscore that enrollment of patients in clinical trials should be considered in order to ensure continued progress.
abstract.textZh: 移植以及靶向和免疫療法的革命已經將多發性骨髓瘤從一種具有相關存活幾年的疾病轉變為一種功能性治療是新興目標的疾病。 這種豐富的有效療法創造了臨牀複雜性。 在這裡，我們提供了一個實用的框架，以試驗證據為基礎，並以新興的生物學發現為基礎，用於在疾病範圍內導航治療決策。 我們概述了新診斷疾病的細胞遺傳和基因組風險分層、功能適應性和可測量的殘留疾病狀態如何個體化治療，其中四元組誘導療法現在已成為標準，並且正在重新評估自體移植的作用。 關於復發，我們解決了B細胞成熟抗原定向嵌合抗原受體（ CAR ） T細胞，雙特異性抗體和抗體-藥物偶聯物的測序，強調T細胞適應性和多原體靶向以對抗疲憊和抗原逃逸。 我們還考慮在高風險冒煙型骨髓瘤中進行早期攔截。 在整個過程中，我們強調應考慮在臨牀試驗中招募患者，以確保持續進展。

articles.title: Outbreak of Severe Methemoglobinemia during Maritime Migration
articles.authors: Bernasconi L, Lonati D, Teresi A, D'Arca F, Ricca N, Merli D, Pes M, Rotolo A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Migrants crossing the Central Mediterranean sea route travel in overcrowded vessels, where fuel may leak and contaminate seawater accumulating on the vessel floor, resulting in prolonged dermal exposure and fuel-related skin injuries. Since March 2024, clusters of cases of severe acquired methemoglobinemia with no apparent cause have been identified by clinicians in Lampedusa at disembarkation among migrants arriving in Italy.
abstract.textZh: 穿越地中海中部海路的移民乘坐過度擁擠的船隻，燃料可能會洩漏並污染積聚在船底的海水，從而導致長時間的皮膚暴露和與燃料相關的皮膚傷害。自2024年3月以來，蘭佩杜薩（ Lampedusa ）的臨牀醫生在抵達意大利的移民下船時發現了一系列沒有明顯原因的嚴重後天性變性血紅蛋白血症病例。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a coordinated clinical and toxicologic investigation to characterize these cases and identify the underlying cause. Biologic samples were obtained from a subset of patients and analyzed for methemoglobin-inducing agents. A fuel sample from a vessel associated with one of the case clusters was also analyzed.
abstract.textZh: 我們進行了協調的臨牀和毒理學調查，以表徵這些病例並確定潛在原因。從患者子集獲得生物樣本，並分析變性血紅蛋白誘導劑。還分析了與其中一個病例集羣相關的船隻的燃料樣本。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Between March 2024 and December 2025, a total of 82 patients with severe acquired methemoglobinemia were identified, 90% of whom were male; the median age of the patients was 22.5 years (interquartile range, 19.5 to 28.0). The median methemoglobin level at presentation was 44.6% (interquartile range, 32.0 to 55.7), with 43% of the patients having a level of 50% or greater. Methylene blue therapy was used in 90% of the patients, often in repeated doses. Hemolytic anemia occurred as a delayed complication in 38 patients, frequently leading to blood transfusion. Two patients died. Toxicologic analysis identified N-methylaniline (a gasoline additive) or its metabolites in 37 of 39 tested patients (95%) and N-methylaniline at a concentration of 1.1% in the fuel sample from the vessel.
abstract.textZh: 在2024年3月至2025年12月期間，共確診82名嚴重後天性變性血紅蛋白血症患者，其中90%為男性；患者的中位年齡為22.5歲（四分位數間距為19.5至28.0 ）。呈現時的中位變性血紅蛋白濃度為44.6% （四分位數範圍為32.0至55.7 ） ， 43%的患者濃度為50%或更高。90%的患者使用了亞甲藍治療，通常以重複劑量進行。溶血性貧血在38名患者中作為延遲併發症發生，經常導致輸血。兩名患者死亡。毒理學分析在39名測試患者中的37名（ 95 ％ ）中確定了N-甲基苯胺（一種汽油添加劑）或其代謝物，並在來自血管的燃料樣本中確定了濃度為1.1 ％的N-甲基苯胺。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: This investigation identified dermal absorption of the gasoline additive N-methylaniline from fuel-contaminated seawater as the likely cause of recurrent, life-threatening methemoglobinemia associated with maritime migration. These findings underscore the importance of methylene blue availability and frontline diagnostic capacity in settings where similar exposure conditions may occur.
abstract.textZh: 這項調查確定了汽油添加劑N-甲基苯胺從燃料污染的海水中的皮膚吸收是與海上遷移相關的復發性危及生命的高血紅蛋白血症的可能原因。這些發現強調了亞甲藍可用性和前線診斷能力在可能發生類似暴露條件的環境中的重要性。

articles.titleZh: 海上遷徙期間嚴重變性血紅蛋白血症的爆發

articles.title: Complete Revascularization Guided by Functional Coronary Angiography in STEMI
articles.authors: Biscaglia S, Erriquez A, Colaiori I, Hakeem A, Mantovani F, Menozzi M, Barbierato M, Arioti M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Complete coronary-artery revascularization is recommended in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) and multivessel disease, but the preferred strategy for identifying nonculprit lesions that warrant treatment remains uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 建議ST段擡高型心肌梗死(STEMI)和多支血管疾病患者進行完整的冠狀動脈血運重建，但確定需要治療的非病竈的首選策略仍然不確定。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this international, randomized trial, we assigned patients with STEMI and multivessel disease in whom the culprit lesion had been successfully treated to undergo complete coronary-artery revascularization guided by functional coronary angiography (physiology-guided group) or by conventional angiography (angiography-guided group). The primary outcome was a composite of death from any cause, myocardial infarction, cerebrovascular accident (stroke or transient ischemic attack), or ischemia-driven revascularization, assessed in a time-to-event analysis. The primary safety outcome was a composite of contrast-associated acute kidney injury or major bleeding.
abstract.textZh: 在這項國際隨機試驗中，我們將STEMI和多支血管疾病患者中已成功治療病竈的患者分配到功能性冠狀動脈造影（生理學引導組）或傳統血管造影（血管造影引導組）引導的完全冠狀動脈血運重建。主要結果是任何原因導致的死亡、心肌梗塞、腦血管意外（中風或短暫性缺血發作）或缺血驅動的血運重建的綜合結果，在時間到事件分析中進行評估。主要安全性結果是造影劑相關的急性腎損傷或大出血的綜合結果。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 1823 patients underwent randomization; 913 were assigned to the physiology-guided group and 910 assigned to the angiography-guided group. The median age of the patients was 66 years (interquartile range, 58 to 76), and 24% were women. At a median follow-up of 17.9 months, a primary-outcome event had occurred in 81 patients (8.9%) in the physiology-guided group and in 125 patients (13.7%) in the angiography-guided group (hazard ratio, 0.62; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.47 to 0.83; P<0.001). A primary-safety-outcome event occurred in 42 patients (4.6%) in the physiology-guided group and in 65 patients (7.1%) in the angiography-guided group (hazard ratio, 0.63; 95% CI, 0.43 to 0.93; P = 0.02).
abstract.textZh: 共有1823名患者接受隨機分組； 913名被分配到生理學引導組， 910名被分配到血管造影引導組。患者的中位年齡為66歲（四分位數範圍為58至76歲） ，其中24%為女性。在中位隨訪17.9個月時，生理學引導組的81名患者（ 8.9% ）和血管造影引導組的125名患者（ 13.7% ）發生了主要結局事件（風險比， 0.62 ； 95%可信區間[CI] ， 0.47至0.83 ； P < 0.001 ）。主要安全性結局事件發生在生理學引導組的42名患者（ 4.6% ）和血管造影引導組的65名患者（ 7.1% ） （風險比， 0.63 ； 95% CI ， 0.43至0.93 ； P = 0.02 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In patients with STEMI and multivessel coronary artery disease, a strategy of complete coronary-artery revascularization guided by functional coronary angiography resulted in a lower risk of a primary-outcome event (death, myocardial infarction, cerebrovascular accident, or ischemia-driven revascularization) than a strategy guided by conventional angiography. (Funded by the Italian Health Ministry and others; AIR-STEMI ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05818475.).
abstract.textZh: 在STEMI和多血管冠狀動脈疾病患者中，由功能性冠狀動脈造影引導的完全冠狀動脈血管重建策略導致主要結局事件（死亡、心肌梗塞、腦血管意外或缺血驅動的血管重建）的風險低於傳統血管造影引導的策略。（由義大利衛生部和其他機構資助； AIR-STEMI ClinicalTrials.gov編號為NCT05818475。）。

articles.titleZh: STEMI功能性冠狀動脈造影引導的完全血運重建

articles.title: Exa-cel in Children with Transfusion-Dependent β-Thalassemia or Sickle Cell Disease
articles.authors: Frangoul H, de la Fuente J, Chopra Y, Meisel R, Amrolia PJ, Algeri M, Sharma A, Cappellini MD, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Exagamglogene autotemcel (exa-cel) is a cell therapy in which autologous CD34+ hematopoietic cells are engineered through ex vivo clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats-Cas9 editing of the erythroid-specific enhancer region of BCL11A to express fetal hemoglobin. In phase 3 studies involving participants 12 to 35 years of age with sickle cell disease or transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia, exa-cel eliminated vaso-occlusive crises and the need for red-cell transfusions.
abstract.textZh: Exagamglogene autotemcel (exa-cel)是一種細胞療法，其中自體CD34 +造血細胞通過離體聚集規律間隔的短回文重複-Cas9編輯BCL11A的紅細胞特異性增強子區域以表達胎兒血紅蛋白。在涉及12至35歲患有鐮狀細胞病或輸血依賴性β地中海貧血的參與者的3期研究中， exa-cel消除了血管閉塞危機和紅細胞輸血的需要。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In two ongoing, phase 3, open-label, single-group studies, we evaluated exa-cel in children 5 to 11 years of age with transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia or sickle cell disease. Before exa-cel infusion, participants underwent myeloablative conditioning with pharmacokinetically dose-adjusted busulfan. The primary end points were transfusion independence for at least 12 consecutive months in children with transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia and freedom from severe vaso-occlusive crises for at least 12 consecutive months in children with sickle cell disease.
abstract.textZh: 在兩項正在進行的3期、開放標籤、單組研究中，我們評估了5至11歲患有輸血依賴性β地中海貧血或鐮狀細胞病的兒童的exa-cel。在exa-cel輸注之前，參與者接受經藥物動力學劑量調整的busulfan進行清髓性調節。主要終點是在患有輸血依賴性β地中海貧血的兒童中至少連續12個月的輸血獨立性，以及在患有鐮狀細胞病的兒童中至少連續12個月沒有嚴重的血管閉塞危機。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 15 children with transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia and 11 with sickle cell disease received exa-cel; median follow-up was 16.0 months (range, 2.2 to 32.1) and 16.9 months (range, 7.6 to 33.1), respectively. Of 8 children with transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia who were followed to at least 16 months, 8 were transfusion independent; the status of the remaining 7 was not yet evaluable. Of 8 children with sickle cell disease who were followed to at least 16 months, 8 were free of vaso-occlusive crises; the status of the remaining 3 was not yet evaluable. All the children had at least one grade 3 or 4 adverse event; 2 children with transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia had severe veno-occlusive liver disease that was assessed as being related to busulfan conditioning, 1 of whom died.
abstract.textZh: 共有15名患有輸血依賴性β地中海貧血的兒童和11名患有鐮狀細胞病的兒童接受了exa-cel ；中位隨訪期分別為16.0個月（範圍2.2至32.1 ）和16.9個月（範圍7.6至33.1 ）。在至少追蹤16個月的8名輸血依賴性β地中海貧血兒童中， 8名兒童輸血無關；其餘7名兒童的狀態尚無法評估。在隨訪至少16個月的8名鐮狀細胞病患兒中， 8名沒有血管閉塞危機；其餘3名的狀況尚無法評估。所有兒童至少發生一次3級或4級不良事件； 2名輸血依賴性β地中海貧血兒童患有嚴重靜脈閉塞性肝病，被評估為與Busulfan調節有關，其中1人死亡。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Exa-cel therapy resulted in transfusion independence or freedom from severe vaso-occlusive crises in participants with transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia or sickle cell disease, respectively, who were followed for at least 16 months. All the participants had grade 3 or 4 adverse events. (Funded by Vertex Pharmaceuticals and CRISPR Therapeutics; CLIMB THAL-141 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05356195; CLIMB SCD-151 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05329649.).
abstract.textZh: Exa-cel治療分別使患有輸血依賴性β地中海貧血或鐮狀細胞病的參與者產生輸血獨立性或免於嚴重血管閉塞危機，這些參與者被隨訪至少16個月。所有參與者均有3或4級不良事件。（由Vertex Pharmaceuticals和CRISPR Therapeutics資助；攀登THAL-141 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05356195 ；攀登SCD-151 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05329649。）。

articles.titleZh: 患有輸血依賴性β地中海貧血或鐮狀細胞病的兒童的Exa-cel

articles.title: Obinutuzumab or Tacrolimus in Primary Membranous Nephropathy
articles.authors: Fervenza FC, Hou FF, Hao CM, Kirsztajn GM, Gesualdo L, Hryszko T, Pisani A, Roccatello D, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Studies of obinutuzumab, a type II anti-CD20 antibody, have shown efficacy in the treatment of hematologic cancers and autoimmune diseases. An evaluation of the efficacy and safety of obinutuzumab in patients with primary membranous nephropathy is needed.
abstract.textZh: II型抗CD20抗體obinutuzumab的研究已顯示在治療血液癌症和自身免疫性疾病方面的有效性。需要評估obinutuzumab在原發性膜腎病患者中的療效和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In a phase 3 trial, we randomly assigned adults with primary membranous nephropathy in a 1:1 ratio to receive intravenous obinutuzumab or oral tacrolimus. The primary end point was complete remission (defined as a urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio of 0.3 or lower and a stable estimated glomerular filtration rate [eGFR]) at week 104. Key secondary end points were complete or partial remission at week 104, complete remission at week 76, a sustained reduction in the eGFR of at least 30%, duration of complete remission, and change in the Patient-Reported Outcomes Measurement Information System Fatigue T score from baseline to week 104. Fixed-sequence hierarchical testing was performed. Safety was assessed.
abstract.textZh: 在一項3期試驗中，我們以1: 1的比例隨機分配患有原發性膜性腎病的成人接受靜脈注射obinutuzumab或口服他克莫司。主要終點是第104週的完全緩解（定義為尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率為0.3或更低，以及穩定的估計腎小球濾過率[eGFR] ）。次要關鍵終點為第104週的完全或部分緩解、第76週的完全緩解、eGFR持續降低至少30%、完全緩解的持續時間，以及患者報告結果測量資訊系統疲勞T評分從基線到第104週的變化。執行固定序列階層式測試。已評估安全性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 142 patients underwent randomization. At week 104, complete remission was observed in 26 of 71 patients in the obinutuzumab group and in 4 of 70 patients in the tacrolimus group (37% vs. 6% with multiple imputation for missing data; adjusted difference, 31 percentage points; 95% CI, 18 to 44; P<0.001). The analyses of complete or partial remission at week 104 and complete remission at week 76 also showed a significant treatment effect. The analysis of a sustained eGFR reduction did not show a significant treatment effect; thus, subsequent end points in the hierarchy were not formally tested for significance. Adverse events of grade 3 or higher were reported in 16 patients (22%) in the obinutuzumab group and in 13 patients (19%) in the tacrolimus group; serious adverse events occurred in 12 (17%) and 10 (14%), respectively. There were 61 and 57 infections per 100 patient-years in the obinutuzumab and tacrolimus groups, respectively; 3 and 4 serious infections per 100 patient-years; and 11 and 14 serious adverse events per 100 patient-years. Adverse drug reactions with obinutuzumab included infusion-related reactions, respiratory tract infections, and neutropenia. One patient in each group died during escape therapy.
abstract.textZh: 共有142名患者接受了隨機分組。 在第104週，在奧比妥珠單抗組的71名患者中的26名和他克莫司組的70名患者中的4名中觀察到完全緩解（ 37%對6% ，缺失數據的多重填補；調整差異， 31個百分點； 95% CI ， 18至44 ； P < 0.001 ）。 第104週完全或部分緩解和第76週完全緩解的分析也顯示出顯著的治療效果。 持續eGFR減少的分析沒有顯示出顯著的治療效果；因此，階層中的後續終點沒有正式測試其顯著性。 Obinutuzumab組有16名患者（ 22% ）報告了3級或以上的不良事件，他克莫司組有13名患者（ 19% ）報告了3級或以上的不良事件；嚴重不良事件分別發生在12名（ 17% ）和10名（ 14% ）。 Obinutuzumab和tacrolimus組分別每100患者年有61和57例感染；每100患者年有3和4例嚴重感染；每100患者年有11和14例嚴重不良事件。 Obinutuzumab的不良藥物反應包括輸注相關反應、呼吸道感染和嗜中性白血球缺乏症。 每組有一名患者在逃脫治療期間死亡。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Obinutuzumab was superior to tacrolimus in inducing complete remission in patients with primary membranous nephropathy. (Funded by F. Hoffmann-La Roche; MAJESTY ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04629248.).
abstract.textZh: Obinutuzumab在原發性膜腎病患者中誘導完全緩解方面優於他克莫司。（由F. Hoffmann-La Roche資助； MAJESTY ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT04629248。）。

articles.titleZh: Obinutuzumab或他克莫司在原發性膜性腎病中的應用

articles.title: Loberamisal for Acute Ischemic Stroke: The LAIS Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Li S, Feng B, He D, Wang X, Li H, Xu S, Gu HQ, Xiao X, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Effective neuroprotective and neuroreparative therapies for acute ischemic stroke remain limited. Loberamisal is a small-molecule compound that dually targets the postsynaptic density 95 (PSD-95) pathway and α2 γ-aminobutyric acid type α (α2-GABAA) receptor.
abstract.textZh: 急性缺血性中風的有效神經保護和神經修復療法仍然有限。Loberamisal是一種小分子化合物，雙重靶向突觸後密度95 (PSD-95)通路和α2 γ-氨基丁酸型α (α2-GABAA)受體。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of intravenous loberamisal for improving functional outcomes in patients with acute ischemic stroke.
abstract.textZh: 評估靜脈注射loberamisal改善急性缺血性卒中患者功能結局的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: The Loberamisal for Acute Ischemic Stroke (LAIS) trial was a multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled phase 3 clinical trial conducted at 32 hospitals in China. Adults aged 18 to 80 years with acute ischemic stroke, a baseline National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale score of 7 to 20, and no prestroke disability (modified Rankin Scale score, ≤1) who presented within 48 hours of symptom onset were enrolled between July 24, 2024, and December 7, 2024, with final follow-up on April 8, 2025.
abstract.textZh: Loberamisal for Acute Ischemic Stroke (LAIS)試驗是在中國32家醫院進行的多中心、雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照3期臨牀試驗。在2024年7月24日至2024年12月7日期間，招募了18至80歲的急性缺血性中風患者，基線期美國國立衛生研究院中風量表評分為7至20分，並且在症狀發作後48小時內出現無中風前殘疾（改良Rankin量表評分， ≤ 1 ） ，最終隨訪日期為2025年4月8日。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Participants were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive intravenous loberamisal (40 mg) or matching placebo once daily for 10 consecutive days, in addition to standard stroke care.
abstract.textZh: 除了標準的中風治療外，參與者被隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ）接受靜脈注射loberamisal （ 40毫克）或相應的安慰劑，每天一次，連續10天。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was achieving a full functional outcome at 90 days, defined as a modified Rankin Scale (mRS) score of 0 to 1. Safety outcomes included adverse events, serious adverse events, and mortality.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是在90天時達到完整的功能結果，定義為0至1的修正Rankin量表（ mRS ）評分。安全性結果包括不良事件、嚴重不良事件和死亡率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 998 randomized participants, 997 received at least 1 dose of the study drug and were included in the primary analysis (502 in the loberamisal group and 495 in the placebo group). The median age was 64 years (IQR, 57-71), 336 participants (33.7%) were women, and the median baseline NIHSS score was 8 (IQR, 7-9). At 90 days, 350 participants (69.7%) in the loberamisal group achieved an mRS score of 0 to 1 compared with 279 (56.3%) in the placebo group (relative risk, 1.24; 95% CI, 1.12-1.36; risk difference, 13.28%; 95% CI, 7.24%-19.32%). Adverse events occurred in 441 participants (87.8%) in the loberamisal group and 439 (88.7%) in the placebo group. Serious adverse events occurred in 43 participants (8.6%) in the loberamisal group and 53 (10.7%) in the placebo group. All-cause mortality occurred in 6 participants (1.2%) in the loberamisal group and 10 (2.0%) in the placebo group.
abstract.textZh: 在998名隨機分配的參與者中， 997人接受了至少1劑的研究藥物，並被納入主要療效分析（ loberamisal組502人，安慰劑組495人）。中位數年齡為64歲（ IQR ， 57-71 ） ， 336名參與者（ 33.7% ）為女性，中位數基線NIHSS評分為8 （ IQR ， 7-9 ）。在90天時， loberamisal組的350名參與者（ 69.7% ）的mRS評分為0至1 ，而安慰劑組的mRS評分為279 （ 56.3% ） （相對風險， 1.24 ； 95% CI ， 1.12-1.36 ；風險差異， 13.28% ； 95% CI ， 7.24% -19.32% ）。loberamisal組的441名參與者（ 87.8 ％ ）和安慰劑組的439名參與者（ 88.7 ％ ）發生不良事件。loberamisal組的43名參與者（ 8.6% ）和安慰劑組的53名參與者（ 10.7% ）發生嚴重不良事件。全因死亡率發生在loberamisal組的6名參與者（ 1.2% ）和安慰劑組的10名參與者（ 2.0% ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Among patients with acute ischemic stroke treated within 48 hours of symptom onset, intravenous loberamisal, compared with placebo, resulted in a higher proportion of patients achieving full functional outcomes at 90 days. Further studies are needed to validate these findings and establish whether the benefits could extend to a broader patient population.
abstract.textZh: 在症狀發作後48小時內治療的急性缺血性中風患者中，與安慰劑相比，靜脈注射loberamisal導致更高比例的患者在90天時達到完全功能結果。需要進一步的研究來驗證這些發現，並確定這些益處是否可以延伸到更廣泛的患者羣體。

articles.title: Rheumatoid Arthritis in Adults: A Review
articles.authors: Smolen JS, Kerschbaumer A, Aletaha D, Robinson WH

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disease that causes inflammation and destruction of cartilage and adjacent bone and can lead to irreversible disability. Rheumatoid arthritis affects 0.53% of adults worldwide and 0.74% of US adults.
abstract.textZh: 類風濕性關節炎（ RA ）是一種慢性自身免疫性疾病，會導致軟骨和鄰近骨骼的炎症和破壞，並可能導致不可逆轉的殘疾。類風濕性關節炎影響全球0.53%的成年人和0.74%的美國成年人。

abstract.label: OBSERVATIONS
abstract.text: Rheumatoid arthritis is more common among females than males (2:1) and has a peak incidence at ages 55 to 75 years. Rheumatoid arthritis can affect all synovial joints, and extra-articular involvement may include rheumatoid nodules, vasculitis, and rheumatoid lung disease. At diagnosis, approximately 40% to 60% of patients have autoantibodies (eg, rheumatoid factor and/or anticitrullinated peptide antibodies). There are no formal diagnostic criteria for RA, so the diagnosis is based on clinical history, characteristic joint swelling in proximal interphalangeal, metacarpophalangeal, and/or wrist joints and often presence of autoantibodies and elevated C-reactive protein levels. Early diagnosis, ideally within 6 weeks of symptom onset, allows rapid initiation of therapy with disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs), which inhibit inflammation and decrease the risk of joint destruction. The goal of treatment is to achieve at least 50% improvement in disease activity by 3 months and remission or low disease activity at 6 months, measured by validated indexes such as the Clinical Disease Activity Index (CDAI). The European Alliance of Associations for Rheumatology recommends starting treatment with methotrexate, 7.5 mg to 10 mg orally weekly, increasing to 20 mg to 25 mg weekly within 4 to 8 weeks, and considering addition of short-term glucocorticoids (eg, prednisone, 5-7.5 mg/d), tapered and discontinued within 3 months, or 1 intramuscular injection of 80 mg to 160 mg depot methylprednisolone. For patients with contraindications to methotrexate, sulfasalazine (2-4 g/d) or leflunomide (20 mg/d) is recommended. With treatment, about 40% of patients with newly diagnosed RA achieve CDAI remission within 6 months. abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: The optimal initial fraction of inspired oxygen (Fio2) for delivery room resuscitation of neonates born at 32 to 35 weeks' gestation is unknown.
abstract.textZh: 對於懷孕32至35週出生的新生兒，用於產房復甦的吸入氧氣（ Fio2 ）的最佳初始分數是未知的。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To compare outcomes for neonates born at 32 to 35 weeks' gestation when initiating resuscitation with Fio2 0.30 vs 0.21.
abstract.textZh: 用FIO2 0.30與0.21比較在懷孕32至35週時出生的新生兒在開始復甦時的結果。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Unblinded, cluster randomized crossover trial in 26 Australian maternity hospitals, including tertiary, nontertiary, metropolitan, regional, public, and private sites, using a waiver of informed consent. All neonates born at participating sites at 32 to 35 weeks' gestation without known major congenital anomalies who commenced respiratory support within 3 minutes of birth were enrolled from December 2022 to September 2025, with final follow-up in March 2026. Statistical analysis was conducted on October 29, 2025.
abstract.textZh: 在26家澳大利亞產科醫院（包括三級、非三級、大都市、區域、公共和私人醫院）進行的非盲、叢集隨機交叉試驗，使用知情同意豁免。從2022年12月至2025年9月，所有在妊娠32至35週時在參與研究中心出生且未發現重大先天性異常且在出生後3分鐘內開始呼吸支援的新生兒均已入組，並於2026年3月進行最終追蹤。統計分析於2025年10月29日進行。

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Sites were randomly assigned to provide initial Fio2 of either 0.30 or 0.21 during the first 3 minutes of delivery room respiratory support. Sites crossed over to provide the alternative initial Fio2 halfway through their recruitment period.
abstract.textZh: 在分娩室呼吸支持的前3分鐘內，隨機分配研究中心提供0.30或0.21的初始Fio2。網站在招募期中途交叉，以提供替代的初始Fio2。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was ongoing respiratory support when leaving the delivery room. Twelve secondary outcomes evaluated delivery room treatments and respiratory support until discharge.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是離開分娩室時持續的呼吸支援。十二個次要結果評估了分娩室治療和出院前的呼吸支持。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 1818 eligible newborns (mean gestational age, 34.1 weeks; mean birth weight, 2165 g; 44.7% female) were included. Ongoing respiratory support when leaving the delivery room occurred in 700 of 964 newborns (72.6%) randomized to receive Fio2 0.30 and 626 of 854 newborns (73.3%) randomized to receive Fio2 0.21 (risk difference, -0.83 [95% CI, -4.33 to 2.67]). Of the 12 secondary outcomes, 10 were not significantly different between newborns randomized to receive Fio2 0.30 vs 0.21, while 2 were. Newborns randomized to receive Fio2 0.30 were less likely to receive higher levels of support in the delivery room, including noninvasive positive pressure ventilation (606 of 964 [62.9%] vs 560 of 854 [65.6%]), endotracheal or supraglottic airway ventilation (20 of 964 [2.1%] vs 24 of 854 [2.8%]), or cardiac compressions or epinephrine (19 of 964 [2.0%] vs 25 of 854 [2.9%]; proportional odds ratio, 0.70 [95% CI, 0.52-0.95]). Fewer newborns in the Fio2 0.30 group received endotracheal ventilation beyond the delivery room (61 of 959 [6.4%] vs 79 of 852 [9.3%]; risk ratio, 0.69 [95% CI, 0.47-0.91]).

articles.title: Influence of Physician Behaviors on How Patients Interpret Normal Test Results
articles.authors: Kube T, Seewald A

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Reassuring patients that nothing serious is wrong is one of the most common interventions in family medicine. However, medical reassurance can sometimes fail, and it is not yet clear what role the doctor's behavior plays in this regard. We tested the preregistered hypothesis that a doctor's warmth and competence significantly and independently influence patients' responses to normal results from diagnostic testing.
abstract.textZh: 向患者保證沒有任何嚴重問題是家庭醫學中最常見的幹預措施之一。然而，醫療保證有時會失敗，目前還不清楚醫生的行為在這方面扮演什麼角色。我們測試了預先註冊的假設，即醫生的溫暖和能力顯著且獨立地影響患者對診斷測試正常結果的反應。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We used an online convenience sample reporting medium somatic symptom burden (N = 349, mean age 29.9 years, 79% female) and completed an experimental analog study. After presentation of a symptom vignette, participants watched a videotaped medical report in which a doctor provided the results of diagnostic tests, stating that no abnormality had been identified. Whereas the diagnostic information was always the same, the doctor's behavior differed in terms of warmth (high vs low) and competence (high vs low).
abstract.textZh: 我們使用在線便利樣本報告中等軀體症狀負擔（ N = 349 ，平均年齡29.9歲， 79 ％為女性） ，並完成了一項實驗類比研究。在呈現症狀暈影後，參與者觀看了一份醫療報告錄像，其中醫生提供了診斷測試的結果，指出沒有發現異常。儘管診斷資訊始終相同，但醫生的行為在溫暖（高與低）和能力（高與低）方面有所不同。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants rated the likelihood of a serious disease significantly lower if the doctor showed high warmth and high competence. Further results showed that high warmth and competence also led to improvements in other outcomes, such as a lower desire to seek another doctor's opinion or additional tests. A mediation analysis indicated that the effects of warmth and competence were modulated by the extent to which participants cognitively (de)valued diagnostic information.
abstract.textZh: 如果醫生表現出高熱情和高能力，參與者對嚴重疾病的可能性評分顯著降低。進一步的結果表明，高熱情和能力也導致其他結果的改善，例如尋求另一位醫生的意見或額外測試的慾望降低。調解分析表明，溫暖和能力的影響受到參與者認知（去）價值診斷信息的程度的調節。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: For patients, diagnostic information does not speak for itself; the doctor's behavior critically determines how they integrate such information. Showing high warmth and competence can help patients put trust in them and update their illness beliefs accordingly.
abstract.textZh: 對於患者來說，診斷資訊並不能說明一切；醫生的行為關鍵決定了他們如何整合這些資訊。展現高度的熱情和能力可以幫助患者信任他們，並相應地更新他們的疾病信念。

articles.title: Interventions to Improve Outpatient Follow-up for Hospitalized Patients With Alcohol Use Disorder : A Systematic Review
articles.authors: Bernstein EY, Hills-Dunlap K, Challapalli A, Bero L, Calcaterra SL, Edelman EJ, Kruse GR, Harnke B, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Hospitalizations for alcohol use disorder (AUD) are common and morbid. Outpatient follow-up after discharge is critical for reducing alcohol use and subsequent readmissions, but effective interventions to support this transition are unknown.
abstract.textZh: 因酒精使用障礙（ AUD ）住院治療是常見且病態的。出院後的門診追蹤對於減少酒精使用和隨後的再入院至關重要，但支持這種過渡的有效幹預措施尚不清楚。

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: To summarize evidence on the effectiveness of hospital-based interventions to improve outpatient follow-up for AUD.
abstract.textZh: 總結有關以醫院為基礎的幹預措施有效性的證據，以改善AUD的門診隨訪。

abstract.label: DATA SOURCES
abstract.text: Ovid MEDLINE, EMBASE, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, PsycInfo, and CINAHL (January 2000 to February 2025).
abstract.textZh: Ovid MEDLINE、EMBASE、Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials、PsycInfo和CINAHL （ 2000年1月至2025年2月）。

abstract.label: STUDY SELECTION
abstract.text: Two authors independently reviewed abstracts and full-text articles to identify hospital-based trials and cohort studies that evaluated interventions to improve outpatient AUD follow-up versus usual care or an active comparator.
abstract.textZh: 兩位作者獨立審查了摘要和全文文章，以確定以醫院為基礎的試驗和隊列研究，這些試驗和研究評估介入措施，以改善門診AUD隨訪與常規護理或活躍對照者。

abstract.label: DATA EXTRACTION
abstract.text: Study data were extracted by 2 authors using a standardized template. Risk of bias and certainty of evidence were assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias Tool, Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, and GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation).
abstract.textZh: 研究資料由2位作者使用標準化範本提取。使用Cochrane Risk of Bias Tool、Newcastle-Ottawa Scale和GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation)評估偏誤風險和證據的確定性。

abstract.label: DATA SYNTHESIS
abstract.text: Seventeen studies of 21 interventions (12 randomized clinical trials [RCTs] [n = 1917], 3 nonrandomized trials [n = 459], and 2 cohort studies [n = 9974]) were included. Interventions were heterogeneous, and most (85%) included several components: behavioral (76%), care coordination (76%), medication management (14%), and social support (33%). Eight interventions (38%) reported improved linkage to outpatient follow-up. Effective interventions generally combined behavioral and care coordination with AUD medications or social support. Effect sizes across RCTs ranged from an 8% absolute decrease to a 30% absolute increase in outpatient follow-up. The certainty of evidence was low due to the high risk of bias and imprecision of results.
abstract.textZh: 納入了21項幹預措施的17項研究（ 12項隨機臨牀試驗[RCT] [n = 1917]、3項非隨機試驗[n = 459]和2項隊列研究[n = 9974] ）。介入是異質的，大多數（ 85 ％ ）包括幾個組成部分：行為（ 76 ％ ）、護理協調（ 76 ％ ）、藥物管理（ 14 ％ ）和社會支持（ 33 ％ ）。八項幹預措施（ 38 ％ ）報告與門診隨訪的聯繫有所改善。有效的幹預措施通常將行為和護理協調與澳元藥物或社會支持結合起來。RCT的效果大小從門診隨訪的8%絕對減少到30%絕對增加不等。由於偏見和結果不準確的風險很高，證據的確定性很低。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Only English-language publications were included.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Few intervention studies of low certainty improved posthospitalization follow-up for patients with AUD. Given the substantial morbidity associated with untreated AUD, high-quality RCTs testing various components of interventions are needed.

articles.authors: Ahmad M, Cleland JGF, Maffia P, Strawbridge RJ, Sattar N, Pell JP, Liu Q, Friday JM, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The 1959 World Health Organization (WHO) definition of anemia is widely used, but its relationship with mortality in the general adult population is uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 1959年世界衛生組織（ WHO ）對貧血的定義被廣泛使用，但其與一般成年人羣死亡率的關係尚不確定。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Prospective cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 前瞻性隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Population-based cohort in the United Kingdom.
abstract.textZh: 英國的人口基礎羣組。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 502 188 adults (median age, 58 years; 54.4% women) recruited from 2006 to 2010; hemoglobin concentration was measured in 477 876 (95.2%). Analyses were stratified by sex and age (<60 vs. ≥60 years). Median follow-up was 13.6 years.
abstract.textZh: 從2006年至2010年招募了502 188名成人（中位年齡， 58歲； 54.4%婦女） ；在477 876 （ 95.2% ）中測量了血紅蛋白濃度。分析按性別和年齡分層（ < 60 vs. ≥ 60歲）。中位隨訪時間為13.6年。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Hemoglobin concentration categorized relative to WHO sex-specific thresholds (men, <13.0 g/dL; women, <12.0 g/dL). Outcomes were all-cause, cardiovascular, and cancer mortality.
abstract.textZh: 血紅蛋白濃度相對於WHO性別特異性閾值分類（男性， < 13.0 g/dL ；女性， < 12.0 g/dL ）。結果為全因、心血管和癌症死亡率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: All-cause mortality showed a U-shaped association with hemoglobin concentration, with lowest risk 1 to 3 g/dL above the WHO threshold. In the primary adjusted model, the 10-year standardized cumulative incidence (SCI) was 4.5% in the reference group versus 12.5% among participants more than 2 g/dL below the threshold (absolute risk difference [ARD], +8.1 percentage points; 95% CI, 6.7 to 9.4 percentage points); over the entire follow-up, the adjusted hazard ratio (HR) was 2.87 (CI, 2.54 to 3.25). Among those 0 to 1 g/dL above the threshold, the 10-year SCI was 5.3% (ARD, +0.8 percentage points; CI, 0.7 to 1.0 percentage points) and the adjusted HR was 1.18 (CI, 1.15 to 1.21). Associations were less consistent in women younger than 60 years. Patterns for cardiovascular and cancer mortality were similar at low and borderline concentrations but attenuated at higher concentrations.

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Single baseline hemoglobin concentration measurement; predominantly White population.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Mortality was lowest at hemoglobin concentrations 1 to 3 g/dL above current WHO thresholds, with higher mortality below and above this range. These hypothesis-generating findings should not define new thresholds but may inform clinical interpretation and evaluation of borderline hemoglobin concentration values.

articles.title: Tuberculosis
articles.authors: Pillay T, Kon OM, Lalvani A

abstract.text: Tuberculosis (TB) is the leading cause of infection-related mortality in the world, and cases in the United States are increasing. Prompt diagnosis, isolation, and treatment improve patient outcomes and reduce onward transmission. Screening of contacts and high-risk persons for asymptomatic TB infection and treatment of those testing positive reduces progression to disease. TB disease should be suspected in persons with compatible symptoms, risk factors, and consistent imaging. Microbiological confirmation requires an acid-fast smear, nucleic acid amplification test, and culture. Treatment, guided by drug sensitivity testing, requires multiple antibiotics given for 4 to 9 months and monitoring for drug toxicity and clinical response.
abstract.textZh: 結核病（ TB ）是全球感染相關死亡的主要原因，美國的病例正在增加。及時診斷、隔離和治療可改善患者結果並減少繼續傳播。篩選接觸者和無症狀結核病感染的高風險人羣，並治療那些檢測呈陽性的人，可減少疾病進展。在症狀、風險因素和一致的影像學檢查中，應懷疑患者患有結核病。微生物確認需要抗酸塗片、核酸擴增測試和培養。在藥物敏感性測試的指導下，治療需要服用多種抗生素4至9個月，並監測藥物毒性和臨牀反應。

articles.title: Sustaining named GP continuity requires organisational change: a comparative implementation analysis in Finland
articles.authors: Tuompo W, Mäkelä J, Timonen M, Auvinen J

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Maintaining doctor-patient relationship continuity remains a challenge in public primary care in Finland and internationally owing to GP workforce pressures and organisational constraints.
abstract.textZh: 由於全科醫生的勞動力壓力和組織限制，維持醫患關係的連續性仍然是芬蘭和國際公共初級保健的挑戰。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate implementation of a named GP model and explain differences in implementation outcomes between two Finnish primary care units.
abstract.textZh: 評估指定的全科醫生模式的實施情況，並解釋芬蘭兩個初級保健單位之間實施結果的差異。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A quasi-experimental before-after study was conducted in two Finnish primary care units with contrasting organisational settings. Patients were assigned a named GP responsible for non-urgent care. Electronic health record data covering physician consultations over 48 months were analysed.
abstract.textZh: 在兩個芬蘭初級保健單位中進行了準實驗性事前事後研究，組織環境形成對比。患者被指派負責非緊急護理的指定全科醫生。分析了涵蓋48個月內醫師會診的電子健康記錄數據。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Continuity was measured using the Usual Provider of Care (UPC) Index, the St Leonard's Index of Continuity of Care (SLICC), and the Own Patient Ratio (OPR). Implementation outcomes were interpreted using the RE-AIM framework. A segmented interrupted time series model was applied to OPR and SLICC, and UPC analysed using a pre-post design.
abstract.textZh: 使用普通護理提供者（ UPC ）指數、聖倫納德護理持續性指數（ SLICC ）和自身患者比率（ OPR ）來測量連續性。實施結果使用RE-AIM框架來解釋。將分段中斷時間序列模型應用於OPR和SLICC ，並使用前後設計分析UPC。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Named GP continuity was higher in Tuira than in Pudasjärvi across all measures. In Tuira, adoption (OPR 0.88) was high and stable with lower named GP-level variation, while reach (SLICC 0.31) and effectiveness (UPC 0.35) improved but remained modest. Although continuity improved in Pudasjärvi, adoption remained weaker (OPR 0.40), reach lower (SLICC 0.16), and maintenance less stable. Continuity of care with physicians other than the named GP increased more in Pudasjärvi.
abstract.textZh: 在所有措施中， Tuira的命名GP連續性都高於Pudasjärvi。在圖伊拉，採用率（ OPR 0.88 ）高且穩定， GP水平變化較低，而REACH （ SLICC 0.31 ）和有效性（ UPC 0.35 ）有所改善，但仍然適度。雖然Pudasjärvi的連續性有所改善，但採用率仍然較弱（ OPR 0.40 ） ，達到較低（ SLICC 0.16 ） ，維護不太穩定。在Pudasjärvi ，除了指定的全科醫生之外，其他醫生的持續護理增加更多。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: The named GP model was functionally adopted in Tuira but remained largely nominal in Pudasjärvi. Health systems implementing named GP models should prioritise sustained GP presence and organisational alignment to achieve continuity.
abstract.textZh: 命名的GP模型在Tuira功能上採用，但在Pudasjärvi基本上保持名義。實施指定GP模型的衛生系統應優先考慮持續的GP存在和組織一致性，以實現連續性。

articles.titleZh: 維持指定的全科醫生連續性需要組織變革：芬蘭的比較實施分析

articles.title: Recommended point-of-care tests in out-of-hours primary care: a modified Delphi study
articles.authors: Redek L, Brettell R, Payne R, Huibers L, Homar V

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Point-of-care tests (POCTs) are increasingly used to enhance diagnostic accuracy and facilitate rapid clinical decision making in settings with limited laboratory access. However, there is currently no consensus on which POCTs should be routinely available in out-of-hours (OOH) primary care services.
abstract.textZh: 即時檢測（ POCT ）越來越多地用於提高診斷準確性，並在實驗室訪問受限的環境中促進快速臨牀決策。然而，目前尚未就非工作時間（ OOH ）初級保健服務中應定期提供哪些POCT達成共識。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To establish expert consensus on which POCTs should be considered essential or optional in European OOH primary care services.
abstract.textZh: 在歐洲OOH初級保健服務中，應將哪些POCT視為必要或可選的專家共識。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A modified Delphi consensus study involving an international panel of experts from 20 European countries, representing diverse clinical and academic backgrounds in OOH primary care.
abstract.textZh: 一項經過修改的Delphi共識研究，涉及來自20個歐洲國家的國際專家小組，代表OOH初級保健的不同臨牀和學術背景。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: A three-round Delphi process was conducted. Round one assessed current POCT availability via questionnaire. In round two, panellists rated 28 POCTs as essential, optional, or unnecessary. In round three, results were discussed in a structured in-person workshop, followed by anonymous re-voting. Consensus was predefined as ≥66.6% agreement.
abstract.textZh: 進行了三輪德爾斐過程。第一輪通過問卷評估當前POCT的可用性。在第二輪中，專題小組成員將28個POCT評為必要、可選或不必要。在第三輪中，在結構化的現場研討會中討論了結果，然後進行了匿名重新投票。共識預定義為大於或等於66.6%。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Six POCTs achieved consensus as essential: blood glucose, urine dipstick, C-reactive protein, pregnancy testing, electrocardiography, and haemoglobin measurement. Twelve tests were classified as optional, and 10 were deemed unnecessary. Key concerns included inappropriate use, variability in clinician confidence, and patient-driven demand.
abstract.textZh: 六個POCT達成了共識：血糖、尿液試紙、C反應蛋白、妊娠測試、心電圖和血紅蛋白測量。12個測試被歸類為可選， 10個被認為是不必要的。關鍵問題包括不當使用、臨牀醫師信心的變異性以及患者驅動的需求。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This study provides, to the authors' knowledge, the first European consensus on POCT prioritisation in OOH primary care. Implementation of essential POCTs, supported by training and governance, may improve diagnostic efficiency, while optional tests should be tailored to local service needs.
abstract.textZh: 據作者所知，這項研究提供了歐洲對OOH初級保健中POCT優先順序的第一個共識。在培訓和治理的支持下實施必要的POCT可以提高診斷效率，而可選測試應根據當地服務需求量身定制。

articles.title: Diagnostic models for male lower urinary tract symptom management in primary care: a prospective, multicentre, diagnostic accuracy study
articles.authors: Harding C, Agarwal R, Bates J, Bray A, Milosevic S, Thomas-Jones E, Drinnan M, Drake M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Recent research has concluded that primary care assessment and management of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) requires practical resources.

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To develop and independently validate risk-prediction models for three common urological conditions based on a combination of simple, minimally invasive index tests in men with LUTS presenting to primary care.

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A prospective, multicentre, diagnostic accuracy study with independent development and validation cohorts set in 67 general practices in England and Wales.

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: A total of 601 men presenting to primary care with LUTS, 350 in the development cohort and 251 in the validation cohort, underwent index tests - validated symptom assessment, bladder diary, physical examination, serum prostate specific antigen, uroflowmetry, and post-void residual volume estimation. Invasive urodynamic studies provided a diagnostic reference standard. Risk-prediction models for urodynamic diagnoses were developed and then validated in independent cohorts. Discriminative and calibration performance of the risk-prediction models for diagnosing bladder outlet obstruction (BOO), detrusor underactivity (DU), and detrusor overactivity (DO) using the c-index, calibration slope and plot, and sensitivity and specificity of the models was undertaken.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The BOO model from the development cohort demonstrated good discriminative performance (optimism-corrected c-index of 0.80). The models derived from the development cohort for DU and DO demonstrated moderate discriminative ability (optimism-corrected c-indices of 0.64 and 0.67, respectively). Similar estimates of c-index were observed for each model within the independent validation cohort (BOO, 0.82; DU, 0.63; and DO, 0.62).

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Using a combination of simple, non-invasive index tests can accurately predict common urological diagnoses in men with LUTS, potentially facilitating earlier initiation of evidence-based treatments and improved management in primary care.

articles.title: Impact of recurrent urinary tract infections on women: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Glogowska M, Moore M, Hay AD, Butler C, Hayward G

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Many women experience recurrent urinary tract infections (rUTIs) yet their significance for the women affected is poorly described and understood.

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore women's experiences of rUTIs and the impact on their lives.

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A qualitative study embedded in a randomised controlled trial (RCT) of D-mannose with women with clinically defined rUTIs in England and Wales.

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: We conducted semi-structured telephone interviews with 32 women who participated in the RCT. Interviews were audio-recorded and transcribed verbatim. Data were analysed thematically.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Women reported how the experience of rUTIs was burdensome with distressing and debilitating physical symptoms and wider disruptive effects. Women expressed how rUTIs had an impact on different stages of their lives and we identified two types of impact. Internalised impact included the women's emotional response to rUTIs, dread of a recurrence, and maintaining readiness to manage it. Externalised impact encompassed actions in response to rUTIs, including remaining extremely vigilant about recurrences and seeking help as soon as a recurrence was suspected, and the challenges they faced. The women explained how the responses of healthcare professionals (HCPs) when they sought care affected their help-seeking and their self-esteem, and could leave them with a sense of helplessness.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Experience of rUTIs has taught women to be vigilant and proactive about the condition but this was not always matched with understanding and validation on the part of HCPs. When women experiencing rUTIs seek care, clinicians could usefully consider the patient's broader experience of rUTIs, including internalised and externalised impacts.

articles.title: Primary care quality and secondary healthcare utilisation in patients with multimorbidity: a retrospective cohort study
articles.authors: Gao Q, Hayhoe BW, Cicek M, Greenfield G, Otis M, Misirli G, Neves AL, Majeed A, et al.

abstract.text: Background High-quality primary care can improve multimorbidity management but little evidence is available to understand its impact on secondary care use over time. Aim To assess the concurrent and lagged associations between quality of primary care and planned and unplanned secondary care use, examining the modifying role of frailty. Design and Setting A retrospective cohort study included 468,172 patients with multimorbidity in England from the Discover research platform (April 2022-March 2024). Method We used principal component analysis to combine a set of quality indicators (QIs) and assessed the impacts of QIs on both planned and unplanned care using regression models. Results Generally, patients with higher QI attainment also had higher likelihood of outpatient visits, emergency admissions and ED visits. There was a lower lagged odds of elective hospital admissions in the following 12 months among those with higher attainment of multimorbidity-specific QIs. In the complex multimorbidity cohort (≥3 conditions), multimorbidity-specific QIs were longitudinally associated with lower odds of elective admissions and outpatient visits, while generic QIs were related to lower odds of outpatient non-attendance. Conclusion Attainment of generic and multimorbidity QIs was generally associated with slightly increased planned and unplanned care. However, patients for whom we identified higher attainment of multimorbidity-specific QIs had lower odds of elective admissions and outpatient visits, especially for those with complex multimorbidity. Our research suggests that the quality of primary care may influence patients' use of secondary care, with the potential to improve care for people with multimorbidity and warrant further investigation into management strategies.

articles.title: Periconception Parental Red Blood Cell Folate, Vitamin B12, and Birth Defects in Offspring : A Prospective Cohort Study
articles.authors: Chen H, Chen X, Zhang Y, Li M, Yao Q, Wang D, Zhao Q, Peng Y, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Maternal folic acid prevents neural tube defects, but associations of parental folate and vitamin B12 with birth defects remain unclear.
abstract.textZh: 母體葉酸可預防神經管缺陷，但母體葉酸和維生素B12與出生缺陷的關聯仍不清楚。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To quantify associations of parental vitamin B12 and red blood cell (RBC) folate with offspring birth defects.
abstract.textZh: 量化父母維生素B12和紅細胞（ RBC ）葉酸與後代出生缺陷的關聯。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Prospective cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 前瞻性隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Shanghai Preconception Cohort, China.
abstract.textZh: 中國上海Preconception Cohort。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 3032 couples (73 birth defect cases) with biomarkers sampled within 4 months before conception, and 17 765 women (327 birth defect cases) sampled at 4 months' gestation or earlier.
abstract.textZh: 3032對夫婦（ 73例出生缺陷病例）在懷孕前4個月內取樣， 17 765名婦女（ 327例出生缺陷病例）在懷孕4個月或更早時取樣。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Standardized predicted prevalences of birth defects ascertained among live births, stillbirths, and abortions due to fetal abnormalities were estimated using weighted logistic regression.
abstract.textZh: 使用加權邏輯迴歸估計活產、死產和胎兒異常墮胎之間確定的出生缺陷的標準化預測患病率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Higher preconception parental levels of vitamin B12 were associated with lower predicted prevalences of birth defects in dose-response analyses. For preconception maternal vitamin B12 from the lowest (<148 pmol/L) to highest (≥590 pmol/L) categories, predicted prevalence decreased from 49.6 to 16.2 cases per 1000 pregnancies; paternal vitamin B12 showed a similar but attenuated pattern (55.5 to 24.0 cases per 1000 pregnancies). Preconception parental RBC folate showed imprecise patterns of lower predicted prevalence. For postconception maternal RBC folate, predicted prevalence was lower at levels of 906 to 1131 nmol/L than at levels below 453 nmol/L (16.5 vs. 25.7 cases per 1000 pregnancies), with little further reduction at higher levels. For postconception maternal vitamin B12, predicted prevalence changed little across lower categories but was lower at higher levels (11.8 vs. 20.4 cases per 1000 pregnancies at ≥590 vs. 148 to 294 pmol/L, respectively).

abstract.text: Residual confounding.
abstract.textZh: 剩餘的混淆。

abstract.text: Periconception parental vitamin B12 and postconception maternal RBC folate were associated with lower predicted prevalences of birth defects.

articles.title: Ethics and Professionalism in Artificial Intelligence and Medical Practice: A Position Paper From the American College of Physicians
articles.authors: DeCamp M, Snyder Sulmasy L, Karches KE, Ethics, Professionalism and Human Rights Committee of the American College of Physicians

abstract.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) in health care is being rapidly adopted in perhaps one of the most rapid implementations of technology in medicine to date. Better thought of as augmented intelligence, as a tool that provides assistance to physicians and patients, many guidelines for its use have been issued, but consensus has not yet been achieved on issues such as privacy, disclosure, and fairness. Patients and physicians need ethical guidance at the point of care. Three guideposts described in this American College of Physicians position paper and rooted in the patient-physician relationship-principles of medical ethics, clinical integrity, and physician-independent practical reasoning-can inform the ethical use of AI: relationality, self-governance, and competence. This paper examines the implications of AI for patients, physicians, and health care and provides guidance for its ethical use.
abstract.textZh: 醫療保健中的人工智能（ AI ）正在被迅速採用，可能是迄今為止醫學中最快速的技術實施之一。更好地將其視為增強智能，作為為為醫生和患者提供幫助的工具，已經發布了許多使用指南，但在隱私，披露和公平性等問題上尚未達成共識。患者和醫生在護理時需要道德指導。這份美國醫師學會立場文件中描述並植根於病人與醫師關係的三個指南-醫學倫理原則，臨牀誠信和醫師獨立的實踐推理-可以為AI的倫理使用提供信息：關係性，自我治理和能力。本文研究AI對患者、醫生和醫療保健的影響，並為其道德使用提供指導。

articles.title: Understanding Suicide through Coroners' Narratives: implications for primary care from a mixed‑methods study of 157 Coroners' reports
articles.authors: Oliver P, Reed E, Hulin J, Delaney B, Marshall J, Mitchell C

abstract.text: Suicide is a major public health concern, and general practice is often a recent point of contact before death. While mental illness is well recognised, the broader social and contextual factors influencing suicide risk remain under-reported in primary care and epidemiological research Aim To describe the demographic, clinical, and psychosocial characteristics of individuals who died by suicide, integrating coronial quantitative data with qualitative narrative accounts to identify implications for primary/ secondary care and public health. Design and setting Explanatory sequential mixed‑methods study of 157 consecutive deaths by suicide recorded by coroners (2018-19) across five English local authorities. Method Demographic, clinical, and social data were extracted from coroners' records and summarised descriptively. Narrative case summaries were coded and analysed thematically to identify contextual, relational, and service factors preceding death. Results Of 157 individuals: 79% were male; 65% lived in the most deprived IMD quintile; 85% had a diagnosed mental health condition; 62% had a long‑term physical illness; 41% had a previous suicide attempt.
